_risk_level_doc: Single-file JS logic fix in a template. Risk is medium because the accommodation draggable condition touches selectedAccId which is also used by the badge and the board-to-board swap path. Incorrect gating change could silently break the board-to-board swap.

requirement.original: Board cards that are pre-selected by AI planning (from selected_option_id in data files) appear on the left KanbanView panel but are completely locked/non-draggable. The user cannot: 1. Drag the card to the right sidebar to deselect it (slot stays filled, can't be cleared); 2. Drop a candidate from the right panel onto the slot (or it silently fails)
requirement.clarified: Fix JS draggable condition and drop-target gating in react_template.tpl so that AI-selected board cards (where card.selected=true and card.option_id is set by mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay) are draggable and their slots accept candidate drops when editorDay is loaded.
requirement.what: Fix two JS conditions in react_template.tpl: (1) selectedAccId resolution at line 1266 to not return null when edAcc is null; (2) accommodation drop-target isGated at line 1316 to not gate purely on !edAcc
requirement.why: AI-planned selections are stored as selected_option_id on the editor slot, not as option_id on the Python-rendered card. The JS draggable guard uses acc.option_id (absent) and selectedAccId (null in viewer mode), producing draggable=false.

out_of_scope_observations.observation: Meals draggable={isSelected} is correct — merge function sets opt.selected=true and opt.option_id atomically. No fix needed.

Activity card draggable={isSelected && !!slotId} fails in viewer mode because actSlotId/cafeSlotId/entSlotId requires editorDay. This is by-design (viewer mode is read-only). Only manifests as a bug if editorDay is loaded but the slot-map lookup fails — which does not happen for normal AI-planned slots.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: AI-selected board cards have draggable=false; accommodation slot has data-droppable=false
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: selectedAccId at line 1266 returns null when edAcc is null (ternary short-circuits to null). dragOptionId = acc.option_id || selectedAccId = null || null = null. draggable={!!null} = false. Drop-target isGated = !edAcc = !null = true when edAcc is absent.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; original code never handled the null-edAcc case for selectedAccId in the draggable path
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The selectedAccId computation at line 1266 was written defensively for the case where edAcc is null (viewer mode), correctly returning null. But the draggable condition was written assuming acc.option_id would always be present (it is for manually-edited cards), creating a case where both sides of the OR are null for AI-selected cards in initial render.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: AI-planned accommodation uses selected_option_id on the edAcc object, not option_id on the rendered card. The merge function sets acc.option_id during render, but the selectedAccId ternary short-circuits before reading it from editorSelections when edAcc is present but editorSelections doesn't have the key yet.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since AI-planning feature was introduced; not a regression
